title: Tunisian Chicken Tagine
description: A flavorful and aromatic North African stew made with chicken, spices, and dried fruits.
instructions: Heat oil in the bottom of a clay or ceramic tagine or a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add chicken and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add tagine spice blend, carrots, and apricots. Stir to combine.
Add 2 cups of water and bring to a boil.
Cover and transfer to the oven. Bake at 300°F (150°C) for 30-40 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed. If using honey, stir it in during the last 10 minutes of cooking.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs, if desired.
